sloka: सेयमालोक्य मे रूपं जानकी भाषितं तथा ।रक्षोभिस्त्रासिता पूर्वं भूयस्त्रासं गमिष्यति ।। ५.३०.२०।।।।
transliteration: seyamālokya me rūpaṁ jānakī bhāṣitaṁ tathā ।rakṣobhistrāsitā pūrvaṁ bhūyastrāsaṁ gamiṣyati ।। 5.30.20।।।।

translations.english: "Since Janaki has already been frightened by the demons, she will be even more terrified seeing me in this form and hearing me speaking this way.
